limitations: Execution health and observation coverage only; not game-rule or playing-strength certification.
Pairs count correlated observation rows, not independent games or training updates.
Fixed four-matchup pilot is not a representative meta sample. No favorable reseeding, rejected-game replacement or holdout search.
Raw binaries remain unpublished local evidence, bound by SHA-256. Quality manifests and compact row metadata are published.
This frozen split has not been wired into model training; existing random-split trainer must not be represented as using it.
scope: Bounded frozen repeated-matchup collection pilot; training contracts only

regression.before: Old dump silently ignores invalid --matchup 0,0 and creates output.
regression.after: Invalid pair rejected before output open; existing output preserved. One default sentinel binary and deck manifest exactly match old producer; quality matches except NNTrain.dll hash.

worker.verification: Primary verified all per-batch counts/partitions, fault counters, input hashes, call names/game counts/occurrences and aggregate totals from original manifests. Worker scripts not integrated.
worker.correction: Worker informational_call_totals.games=274 sums per-call game incidences, NOT distinct games. Actual unique games with recorded informational calls: 75. The 274 figure is not adopted as game coverage.

decision: Do not scale collection yet: this pilot has sufficient nonzero holdout row-pair coverage for a bounded pipeline test. Next bind composite (batch,local-game) identities and this predeclared holdout to model Train/Verify, then run a small smoke training without seed/label search. Broaden matchups and evaluate independent seeds/policies before strength claims.
